results.summary: Criteria 1 to 6 each checked against shipped evidence: 12 research iterations plus research.md, three and six modes, no id residue in the five mcp-tooling files, parent-skill-check exit 0 naming the hub, one advisor-plus-router pass per mode, and three playbooks with recorded runs including the Bladebro macOS live run. Criterion 7 is unverified because validate.sh --recursive is outside this lineage write surface.

Phase 015 criterion 2 advisor half holds: mcp-code-mode and bare staging are absent from the hub intent signals and description keywords, and the four staging phrases the changelog names live in the advisor explicit lane at 0.65.

noveltyJustification: No new finding this iteration. One refinement: R1-P1-001 downgraded from P1 to P2 on live counterevidence, counted at 0.5x weight = 2.5. Weighted total = 6 carried. Ratio 2.5/6 = 0.4167.
